notes: Setup required: CrownHook starts with no registry or ticker binding, so swaps pay no cut until the owner configures both. A separately deployed CrownRegistry (also exposed as ThroneRegistry) takes genesis arguments CRWN, the deployed CrownToken, and the launch beneficiary represented by $owner. Its address is set once by the owner's setRegistry, not a constructor argument; it accepts only a contract whose code hash equals CrownRegistry or ThroneRegistry compiled with the hook, so the owner picks an instance, never the rules. After initialization the owner calls registerPool with the ETH/CrownToken/12500/60/CrownHook PoolKey, keccak256("CRWN") and 100 bps (range 0-500); it requires a set registry whose king for the ticker is the pool's token, and ticker and cut are then immutable. afterInitialize records the pool with the default 100 bps cut and accepts any initializer, so the launch factory opens the pool. All enabled callbacks require the PoolManager. CrownHook accepts the listed 12500 LP fee, which is separate from its crown cut. Target: Robinhood Chain (4663); the deployer derives the opening price, initialPrice records the launch reference. CrownHook pays the cut in native ETH from the PoolManager to the current king's beneficiary inside the swap and increments crownPaid only after a successful payment. A beneficiary without code (a wallet) is paid by transfer (take); a beneficiary with code is credited an ERC-6909 claim on native ETH in the PoolManager (mint, event CrownClaimMinted) so no beneficiary code runs inside anyone's swap; it redeems in its own transaction via redeem(amount, to) after setOperator(hook, true), where unlockCallback burns only the caller's claims and takes the ETH to the named recipient. The hook never holds funds or claims. beforeSwap/beforeSwapReturnDelta handle ETH-specified swaps, afterSwap/afterSwapReturnDelta token-specified ones; a reverting rehearsal measures partial fills. The payment runs in a self-call (payout, transfer gas bounded at 150k) that reverts, and is skipped, if anything but the hook's own -cut delta changed in the PoolManager. Missing configuration, failed or malformed registry reads, an absent beneficiary, or a reverted payout skip the cut; for a wallet beneficiary a PoolManager holding no ETH skips it and one holding less than the cut pays what it holds, while a contract beneficiary's claim is minted in full since the swapper's own ETH settles it. A fresh tokens-only manager thus executes its first buy without a cut to a wallet. CrownRegistry has no admin: the 0.01 ETH bond counts as challenger stake, a king reigns at least seven days before a challenge, staking lasts 72 hours, finalization follows a 24-hour timelock. During the window a new challenger may displace the live challenge by bonding exactly twice its bond; the displaced one closes at once with all stakes refundable, nothing slashed, no cooldown, no crown change. A challenger wins only with strictly more stake and at least 0.05 ETH total quorum; failure starts a three-day ticker cooldown. The challenge opener becomes the new beneficiary. Losing stake is 80% refundable; the 20% slash is split between winner bonuses and treasury 0xf19f11dee16a341671e6ed3e209b704c1bbc3e57. Winners pull their stakes plus pro-rata bonuses; treasury withdrawal is permissionless. Rounding dust is bounded; an empty winning side sends the whole slash to treasury. The repository also holds CrownChallengerToken, a distinct plain Crown Demo/CRWN ERC-20 with its deploy script, the ticker frontend in web/ (actions enabled only with real deployment data), and a buy-challenge-stake-finalize-buy integration test asserting the recipient flip and crownPaid. This manifest describes the accepted sources; it does not deploy the registry or challenger, perform owner setup, or establish a live demo. README compiler settings: Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer enabled with 44444 runs, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none.
